scripts.lint:deps: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps packages tests tools scripts
scripts.//verify: The TypeScript and browser gate as one command — NOT the whole release gate, and the difference is the one an external review found being taught wrongly here. The full gate before a merge is three commands, and the `release-gate` job in .github/workflows/typescript.yml runs exactly these three: `pnpm verify`, then `node scripts/audit-runtime-dependencies.mjs` (nothing unreviewed reaches a player at runtime), then `dotnet test OathAndCoin.sln -c Release` (the stack the migration has not cut over from is still green). `package:desktop` and `test:desktop` are a fourth thing again and deliberately in neither: they need an Electron binary and a Windows host, so they stay separate commands and a separate CI job. Inside this one, everything is cheapest first, chained with && so the run stops at the first stage that fails and the log ends on the message that matters.
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:deps && pnpm format:check && pnpm schema:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:scenario && pnpm scenario:parity && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
